verdict.rationale: doola is a company-formation and compliance service with a Partner API. It is not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The documented doola Formation MCP server is the server role, where doola exposes tools to a founder's own AI client. That is a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
